claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

Extra generator Q_YBL=aY+b(B-L)/2, b nonzero, is an explicit symbolic family. Source Table I is left-chiral including conjugate RH fermions. Do not normalize a numerical subset of a symbolic full assignment.

E6-inspired charges use Q(theta)=cos(theta)Qchi+sin(theta)Qpsi. Psi requires three full 27-plets; chi may omit non-chiral 10+1. Nonsupersymmetric and supersymmetric interpretations differ and Higgs/extra-singlet completion is not uniquely fixed by a charge table.

Single-S UMSSM Higgs sector contains complex Hu,Hd,S and their chiral superpartners, with source free charges Qu,Qd,QS satisfying QS nonzero,QS+Qu+Qd=0, superpotential lambdaS S Hu Hd. This sector alone does not supply unique exotic/anomaly completion or full numerical fermion charges. Do not identify it with ungauged-U1 NMSSM simply because scalar names agree.
